Date of service: 08/11/2025 | Dr. Bram Fenwick, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
62-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypertension, seasonal allergies.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 25 mg weekly for 39 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 4.5 (moderate disease activity).
Plan: start fictimab 160 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
